description: Directed knowledge graph from the Unified Medical Language System semantic network. Nodes are biomedical concepts and edges are semantic relations (e.g. 'treats', 'diagnoses', 'prevents'). Multiple relation types can connect the same concept pair, making it a directed multigraph. 46 relation types serve as edge attributes.
name: UMLS Knowledge Graph
